logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log Po/w) of FP and DFP was measured using the shake-flask method in the 1-octanol/buffer system. The same volume (2.0 mL) of complex solution and 1-octanol were mixed and placed in an air-bath orbital oscillator overnight at a constant temperature (25.0 ± 0.1 °C) and a rotation speed of 200 RPM. After centrifugation at 2500 RPM for 15 min, the samples were divided into two phases. The concentration of the solute in the aqueous phase was tested by ICP-MS. The log Po/w was calculated using the following equation:log Po/w = log[([c]initial – [c]final)/[c]final]
